name: BITEZ XL - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 4000MG Gummies - Blood Orange Cherry
description:
*DOUBLE THE STRENGTH OF OUR REGULAR BITEZ GUMMIES!

Bold, bright, and impossible to put down. Blood Orange Cherry BITEZ XL Gummies layer deep, tangy blood orange against rich, sun-ripened cherry for a citrus-forward flavor experience that hits different from the very first bite. Tart meets sweet in the most satisfying way imaginable. Double the strength, double the flavor—each XL gummy packs a powerful 2,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (2 gummies per bag, 4,000mg total).
